result:
The candidate is a strong improvement, but `export.sh` still lets data cross between beta and dev, which is on your blocking list. So the verdict is FINDINGS. The restore, provisioning, deploy-root, deploy-input and network fixes all hold, and every round-3 probe is now refused with no docker call. The operator stage (AC3–AC7, browser) was not run; that is yours.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 48810aba327252b58722069ba162cc7b09b507e9
FINDING export-out-unbound blocking: `export.sh beta [output dir]` still takes any output directory. Beta customer-data CSVs can be written into crm-dev's runtime. WO CRM-007R §1 says "export.sh follows the same rule" (bound to its own backup dir), and the PL's blocking list names export. export.sh is unchanged in this candidate; only the CRM_BACKUP_DIR override is refused. | evidence: probe_r.py BetaExport.test_export_beta_out_into_dev_runtime (fake python3 shim logs the export_csv.py argv): `export.sh beta <tmp>/runtime/dev/backups/stolen` with CRM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8280 gives rc 0 and "EXPORT_CSV …/export_csv.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8280 --out <tmp>/runtime/dev/backups/stolen". Same result on base e09dfb8, so it is not fixed. | expected: export.sh beta refuses, before any API call, any output that is not a new directory directly under /srv/CRM/runtime/beta/backups (the beta backup dir under the CRM_TEST_ROOT seam).
FINDING export-dev-url-unpinned blocking: `export.sh dev` still uses CRM_BASE_URL as given, with no check. Pointed at beta's loopback app port, a dev export pulls beta data into dev's backup dir. This is the reverse direction §2 closed for the provisioning scripts. | evidence: probe_r.py DevExport.test_export_dev_with_beta_url: `CRM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8280 export.sh dev` gives rc 0 and "EXPORT_CSV … --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8280 --out <tmp>/runtime/dev/backups/export-20261110T221629Z". Same on base. | expected: export.sh dev accepts only dev's own URL, http://<CRM_BIND_IP from the dev env file>:8180, as check_access.base_url_problem("dev", …) already enforces for provision_access/provision_users.
FINDING restoretest-net-unrestricted advisory: the §5 network allowlist is applied only by check_beta_compose. check_restoretest_compose still accepts any network driver and option. | evidence: check_restoretest_compose with restoretest-net = {"internal":true,"driver":"macvlan"}, {"internal":true,"driver":"bridge","driver_opts":{"com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4":"routed"}} and {"internal":true,"ipam":{…}}: all three ACCEPTED []. The round-3 compose_attack.py, re-run, also still ACCEPTS "rt volume driver other" and "rt secrets". | expected: the restoretest compose gets the same network-spec allowlist (bridge/internal only).
FINDING legacy-unmarked-provenance advisory: `restore.sh dev --legacy-unmarked` accepts any unmarked crm-dev-<stamp> under the dev backup dir, whatever its stamp. A root operator who strips TARGET from a beta backup and renames it could restore it into dev. This matches the PL decision; it is noted only. | evidence: probe_r.py DevExport.test_dev_legacy_with_stripped_beta_backup gives rc 0 with "warning: restoring a legacy dev backup with no TARGET marker". A beta-marked crm-dev-* backup is refused with and without the flag ("TARGET marker is not 'dev'"), stdin not piped. | expected: optionally, accept only stamps earlier than the CRM-007R cut-over.
EVIDENCE:
- HEAD: `git -C /srv/CRM/worktrees/CRM-007R rev-parse HEAD` = 48810aba327252b58722069ba162cc7b09b507e9. Worktree clean (`status --porcelain --ignored` gives 0 lines) at start and end.
- Suites: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/unit` ran 440, OK. `python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t .` ran 112, OK.
- gitleaks: range e09dfb8..48810ab, dir scan and full history all report "no leaks found". No iptables/nft/ufw calls in scripts/ or deploy/.
- Allowlist: all 17 changed files are in scripts/, tests/, docs/BETA.md, or README.md line 52 (inside ## Usage). None outside.
- Round-3 probes re-run against the candidate. probe_cross.py: `restore.sh beta <crm-dev backup>` and `--restoretest` give rc 1, "a beta backup is named crm-beta-<UTC stamp>", docker calls []. provision_access beta with the dev URL gives rc 2 and 0 requests. probe_reverse.py: `restore.sh dev <crm-beta backup>` gives rc 1, refused. compose_attack.py: every beta-compose attack REFUSED.
- Provisioning matrix (probe_r.py Prov, provision_access and provision_users), all refused with rc 2 and 0 HTTP requests: beta with dev URL, trailing slash, localhost, https, CRM_RUNTIME_DIR=dev, CRM_ENV_FILE=dev; dev with beta URL, :8181, runtime=beta. Both targets' own URL proceeds.
- Backup dir: backup.sh, export.sh and restore.sh refuse an overridden CRM_BACKUP_DIR (also an empty one) with rc 2 and 0 docker calls.
- Deploy (probe_dep.py, fake uid 0): with creds, key file or (on --upgrade) CRM_BETA_SAFE_KEY_FILE missing, it refuses before step 1. CRM_DEPLOY_ROOT=/srv/CRM/deploy under the test seam is refused. CRM_TEST_ROOT=/var/tmp/x and /tmp/../srv/CRM are refused. Password not in output; 0 docker calls.
- Network specs: {}, null, bridge and internal:true are accepted. driver null, external, internal:1, driver_opts, name, list/string and a second macvlan network are all refused.
- Non-vacuity: base e09dfb8 scripts with candidate tests/, running test_isolation_007r.py: about 60 FAIL/ERROR, covering every group (cross-env restore both directions, marker rules, backup-dir override, provisioning pins, deploy root/ownership/inputs, network fixtures). My probe_r.py against base: every provisioning case proceeds, a beta-marked crm-dev backup is restored (stdin piped), and the CRM_BACKUP_DIR override is accepted. So the checks fail on base and pass on the candidate.
- Processes: none started (fake docker only, no containers, no listeners). `ss -ltnp | grep python` gives 0.
```
